decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 5 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 30 collided with car 27 in turn 1.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. At the approach to Turn 1, Car 30 attempted to overtake Car 27 on the inside, however missed the apex of the corner, hence was unable to take a normal racing line and consequently collided with the side of Car 27.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
